text: {"name":"rf_build_packet_header","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Writes a 9-byte packet header, conditionally clears bit 0 of one 16-bit field, and selects the final 2 bytes based on another field’s value.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v5":"global_config"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Fixed header byte set to 3."},{"offset":1,"meaning":"Fixed header byte set to 1."},{"offset":2,"meaning":"Caller-supplied 8-bit header field."},{"offset":3,"meaning":"Caller-supplied 16-bit header field; its value also controls the trailing bytes."},{"offset":5,"meaning":"Caller-supplied 16-bit field with bit 0 cleared when the corresponding global configuration byte is zero."},{"offset":7,"meaning":"Trailing 16-bit field; zero when the field at offset 3 is nonzero, otherwise copied from the source structure."},{"offset":14,"meaning":"Source structure’s 16-bit value copied to the header when the field at header offset 3 is zero."}]}
